Name: Fair Farm - Remastered
Author: LordSnowFox
Description:
Fair Farm Remastered replaces the Standard Farm with a farm large enough to house 16 players with decent sized plots of land.
----THERE ARE 2 VERSIONS IN FILES----
Fair Farm Remastered plots have 1000 Plant able tiles on each plot of land.(As Depicted in the pictures above)
Fair Farm Reemastered whiny streamermans edition has 1341 Plant able tiles on each plot of land. 

When creating a new farm simply create a standard farm and the mod will replace it.

If you are stuck trying to get off of the farm pictures have been provided on the mod page to assist on showing how to leave.

WARNING-
1.You should skip the intro as the cutscene with robin taking the player to the farm is still broken im still learning how to fix this issue.

2.The Greenhouse is already expanded on the interior to cater to 16 players so a greenhouse mod will probly still not work.
(This part might get separated in the future but as for now it will remain)
